title: Basic Matrix Implementation

tasks.description: Create matrix package - set up @danielsimonjr/mathts-matrix package with src/, tests/, assembly/, gpu/ directories
Implement Matrix base class - abstract Matrix class with common interface for DenseMatrix and SparseMatrix
Implement DenseMatrix - row-major dense matrix implementation with Float64Array backing store
Matrix indexing and slicing - implement get/set, row(), column(), slice() with view semantics (no copy where possible)
Implement JSBackend - pure TypeScript matrix operation implementations as baseline
Basic operations - implement add, subtract, multiply (element-wise and matrix), transpose in JSBackend
Matrix tests - comprehensive tests for DenseMatrix operations, indexing, slicing, and JSBackend

successCriteria: DenseMatrix stores data efficiently in Float64Array
Matrix indexing is O(1) for element access
Slicing returns views without copying data
All basic operations pass accuracy tests
notes: Sprint 4 implements the core DenseMatrix type with pure TypeScript backend. Features include: Matrix base class, DenseMatrix with Float64Array backing, row/column/slice extraction with view semantics, JSBackend with add/subtract/multiply/transpose operations, and BackendRegistry for pluggable backends. All 88 matrix tests passing (295 total with core tests).
